name: Ziba
whenBasis: In David's reign, ≈1010–970 BC, counted back from Solomon as Thiele and most chronologies do.
summary: A servant of Saul's household, with fifteen sons and twenty servants, who told David of Mephibosheth and was set to farm Saul's land for him. When David fled from Absalom, Ziba met him with donkeys and provisions and told him Mephibosheth was waiting for the kingdom to return to Saul's house; David gave him all Mephibosheth's property. On David's return he rushed to the Jordan to meet him, and was left with half.
body: The text leaves open which of the two told the truth. Mephibosheth's unkempt state since the king left supports his story; David splits the land rather than decide.

moments.text: “You and Ziba are to divide the land”
